text:
[Council File 26-1492]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a 15-year renewal option for Cooperative Agreement No. C-119885 with United Methodist Ministries – Los Angeles District (UMM-LAD) for La Plaza United Methodist Church and the Museum of Social Justice located at 115 Paseo de la Plaza.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. FIND that UMM-LAD has substantially complied with the terms of Cooperative Agreement No. C-119885 (Cooperative Agreement) for 115 Paseo de la Plaza.
2. APPROVE the 15-year renewal option under Section 9 of the Cooperative Agreement, extending the term from November 22, 2026 through November 21, 2041.
3. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument (El Pueblo) Department, to execute the agreement extension and related legal transmittal documents.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The El Pueblo Department reports that continued operation under the Cooperative Agreement ensures complete cost recovery for common area maintenance and departmental oversight without negative impact on the City's General Fund.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 15, 2026
